Overview

Ettelbruck is a city in Diekirch Canton with a population of 8,900. A charming market town in northern Luxembourg at the confluence of the Alzette and Sauer rivers, known as the gateway to the Ardennes. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
